_comment: v3 action-security policy. Exclusions (apps/windows/urls) live in config/capture_policy.json (W0) and are consumed by the perception + action layers. This file governs action TIERS, the privileged execute_cmd sandbox, the kill switch, and the per-app capability-integration registry (Tier 1).

kill_switch.description: Halts all OS interaction and terminates any in-flight execute_cmd subprocess.
